summary: Iteration 7 verified the 5 new 'Rodomisto Rappresentanze' flows around the new read-only GET /api/activities feed and its consumers (Home 'ULTIMO AGGIORNAMENTO' + 'ULTIMI AGGIORNAMENTI' + Vedi tutti → /storico, giro Gestiti click → /gestiti/[id], and Ricorrenze detail 'Gestiti' label). Backend: 13/13 new pytest cases PASSED in /app/backend/tests/test_activities_feed.py — endpoint returns only the 4 allowed types (order/collection/suspension/reschedule) with all required fields (id, type, type_label, created_at, agent, client_ragione_sociale, context), sorted DESC by created_at, capped at 500, type filter correctly narrows results, admin scope=all|umberto|andrea works as spec, and agent Andrea with scope=all or scope=umberto ONLY sees her own activities (no leak from Umberto). Extra sanity via curl: order/collection/suspension have context=company_name (e.g. 'Librandi'), reschedule has context=giro_name (e.g. 'Catanzaro → Guardavalle'). Frontend (Expo web, mobile 390x844): (a) umberto home shows 'ULTIMO AGGIORNAMENTO' with long italian date + 'Ultima attività:' summary AND 'ULTIMI AGGIORNAMENTI' card with 6 rows and the Tutti/Umberto/Andrea chip filter with testIDs upd-filter-{all|umberto|andrea}; (b) 'Vedi tutti' (testID see-all-activities) opens /storico showing 'Storico attività' header, both chip rows sto-type-{all|order|collection|suspension|reschedule} + sto-scope-{all|umberto|andrea}, and toggling type=Ordini + scope=Andrea correctly renders 'Nessuna attività trovata.'; (c) selecting a giro (Catanzaro → Guardavalle) reveals the summary card whose 'Gestiti' item is a Pressable (testID giro-gestiti-btn) that navigates to /gestiti/{id} — the screen shows only ragione_sociale rows ('Azienda agricola Leonardo di Vatrano Elisabetta', '2M Gestioni Srl') with count '2 Gestiti' in header, no other client fields; (d) Ricorrenze → Bonfissuto detail correctly shows the chips 'Da gestire (12)' and 'Gestiti (4)' with ZERO occurrences of 'Effettuati' (rename complete); (e) andrea (agent) sees the home card WITHOUT the Tutti/Umberto/Andrea chips, /storico WITHOUT the scope chip row, and only her own activities are rendered, confirming the admin-gated UI. Pre-existing RN-web deprecation warnings only (shadow* → boxShadow, props.pointerEvents); no red screen and no runtime errors. Regression: existing full backend suite has the 4 stale-fixture failures documented in iteration 6 (Excalibur removed, Eurodrink added, 8th payment mode, giri reorder) — NOT caused by these changes and explicitly out-of-scope per E1.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py L895-940 GET /api/activities: correct read-only implementation. Filters q={deleted_at:None, type:{$in:ACTIVITY_TYPES}}, applies type filter only if in whitelist (safe), non-admin is FORCED to q.agent=user.username BEFORE checking scope so agents can never see other users' feed regardless of ?scope=. Limit clamped to [1..500]. Excludes _id via projection. Efficient: single fetch of events + bulk fetch of clients/giri for join.
